"""Synthetic fixture: ordinary application code for {{NAME}}. Parsed only, never run."""

import json
from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass
class Item:
    key: str
    weight: float


def total(items):
    return sum(item.weight for item in items)


def render(items):
    return json.dumps({item.key: item.weight for item in items}, sort_keys=True)
